turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hi. Is everything all right with your meal?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Not really. I ordered the vegetable pasta, but this has chicken in it.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Oh, I'm really sorry. The kitchen mixed up two orders. The soup of the day is ready now, if you'd like that instead. It's chicken soup.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thanks, but I'm vegetarian. I don't eat meat or chicken. And my lunch break ends in thirty minutes.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I see. The kitchen can make a new vegetable pasta in about fifteen minutes. Or there's a vegetable salad with bread ready now. It's seven dollars, so I'd give you two dollars back.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Is the salad big enough for lunch?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: It's quite big, and it comes with bread. But the pasta is a bigger meal.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: My office is only five minutes away, so I can wait. I'll have the new pasta, please.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: No problem. A new vegetable pasta, no meat, in about fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. Please make sure there's no chicken this time.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Of course. It's completely vegetarian. Sorry again.
